evals.prompt: Set up docs in this repo — we have no documentation structure yet, just a README.
evals.expected_output: Fresh-scaffold path. Surveys the repo, drafts a Diátaxis tree with only the folders needed now and full index.md contents in chat, then waits for confirmation before writing. Does not edit README.md.
assertions: Drafts the proposed tree and landing-page contents in chat before writing
Waits for explicit confirmation before any write
Does not drop a Vale config unprompted

evals.prompt: Our docs are a mess — everything's in one folder. Reorganise to Diátaxis.
evals.expected_output: Reorganise path. Classifies each doc, proposes a move-map and splits, leaves protected_paths in place, waits for approval, then git mv + link fixes.
assertions: Produces a classification table and move-map
Does not move files under docs/architecture/, docs/product/, docs/design/, or docs/brand/
Requires explicit approval before git mv
Fixes inbound and outbound links after moves

evals.expected_output: If docs/ is empty or missing, refuse the reorg and offer a fresh scaffold instead.
assertions: Does not run a reorg against an empty tree
Writes nothing until the user confirms the new path

evals.prompt: Reorganise docs/. There is an ADR under docs/architecture/decisions/ and a messy how-to pile in docs/.
evals.expected_output: Move-map covers the messy how-to pile. docs/architecture/decisions/ is reported as protected and not moved.
assertions: Does not git mv or edit files under docs/architecture/
Still proposes moves for unprotected docs/

evals.prompt: Scaffold a docs folder. Here's the tree I want — go ahead and write it.
evals.expected_output: Still shows the draft in chat and asks for confirmation before writing, even if the user sounds ready.
assertions: Does not write on the first turn without an explicit confirmation gate
Shows full landing-page contents, not just a description
